description: Full edition of SecretSifter for Burp Suite. Adds multi-provider AI Triage (Burp AI, Anthropic, OpenAI), a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server on 127.0.0.1:8765 for Claude Code integration, opt-in live key validation, and always-on live proxy detection on top of the same engine as the BApp Store edition: 150+ anchored vendor token rules, 270+ context-gated rules, entropy heuristics, WebSocket scanning, Bulk Scan, and CSV/HTML/JSON/SARIF export.
author: Hemanth Gorijala
